rows.label: tlk4632017402_msg0001
rows.name:
Moruru-san is a wonderful believer.
I doubt anyone else has such a pure
and upright heart.

rows.label: tlk4632017402_msg0002
rows.name:
This is all thanks to the teachings
of Acedia spoken by Malbeni-sama.

rows.label: tlk4632017402_msg0003
rows.name:
Would you become my disciple too?
Let us head toward a glorious future
together.

rows.label: tlk4632017402_msg0004
rows.name:
I see... I think you would make
a very good believer, so that is
a shame.
